# ascii.rest pieces

Vendored, unmodified modules from [ascii.rest](https://ascii.rest/) by
[@bas3line](https://github.com/bas3line), MIT licensed. See `LICENSE`.

Live pieces, mounted by `js/ascii-live.js`:

- `banner.js` — block-letter banners, including the glint effect.
- `fox.js` — a fox asleep on its tail.

Also vendored, currently unused:

- `radar.js` — rotating radar sweep.

Seasonal field, picked by `js/season-field.js` and animated in the background:

- `cherry-blossom.js` — spring.
- `sunrise.js` — summer.
- `wind.js` — autumn.
- `snowfall.js` — winter.
